facts.fact: The Bank of Tanzania reports 86.34 million interoperable TANQR merchant transactions worth TZS 6,413.14 billion in 2025, with 5 mobile network operators participating.
The Bank of Tanzania reports TANQR connects 27 providers (21 banks, 5 mobile network operators, 1 aggregator) across B2M, M2P and P2M use cases.

systems.tiers: banks, mobile network operators, non-bank aggregator
